A '''Rodian''' with [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] served onboard a [[Unidentified Consular-class cruiser (Noggox)|freighter]] owned by [[Noggox]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="Strange Allies" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Annual">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' places the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. The battle takes place just prior to the ''Secret Missions'' series.</ref> the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] was at the controls of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], along with a [[Unidentified Human (Noggox's freighter)|Human]]. Their cargo was [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brains]] and their destination the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]] when it was intercepted near [[Shipwrights' Trace/Legends|Shipwrights' Trace]] by a [[Unidentified Lucrehulk-class pirate ship|pirate ship]]. The [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] attacked and knocked out two of the freighter's thrusters and its [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]]. The pirate [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Dool Pundar]], then ordered the freighter to surrender, and sent [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s to secure it. The Rodian then joined the crew in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] as Pundar absconded with the freighter. The crew was later safely recovered.<ref name="Strange Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rodian appears in [[2011]]'s ''[[The Clone Wars: Strange Allies]]'', a comic tie-in to the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Secret Missions]]'' series.
